project_type: Expo (SDK 51) / React Native 0.74 + React Native Web POS CRM, mock-data front end (no backend). Dual UI: mobile stack navigators under src/navigation/*, web admin via src/navigation/WebNavigator.tsx.
build_system: Expo / Metro. No separate compile step for dev. Type check via tsc.
test_framework: vitest 2.0.5 (happy-dom). Engine self-test runs via stdout inside src/engine/__tests__/engine.test.ts.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run lint` and compare tsc error count against baseline. Baseline (.agents/tasks/baseline.md) = 13 pre-existing tsc errors in 6 files (BranchSelector.tsx, DatePicker.tsx, PermissionMatrixScreen.tsx, RoleManageScreen.tsx, WebUserStaffScreen.tsx, errorTracking.ts) + logAction arg error. New code MUST add ZERO new tsc errors. Run `npm test`: baseline = 24 tests pass, 3 suites fail to LOAD (engine.test.ts 'no suite', SyncService.test.ts + branchPermissionStore.test.ts react-native/index.js import-analysis) — all pre-existing. New code must not add new failures. There is no server; everything is mock/persisted to local storage.
environment_constraints: Worktree is d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\deferred (branch feat/deferred off main @ 3d2e06a). ALL work happens in this worktree; relative paths resolve here. Never edit d:\pos-mobile directly. npm install already done. Windows + PowerShell shell. Web screens run under react-native-web; web-only APIs (document, window.confirm, window.alert, FileReader) are used in existing web screens and are acceptable there (guard with Platform.OS === 'web' where sibling screens do).
contribution_requirements: Honor .kiro/steering design-system: web screens use src/constants/webColors.ts (WebColors.*) and match sibling web screens; mobile/shared screens use Colors/Typography/Spacing tokens from src/constants/*. All user-facing strings in Thai (labels, placeholders, errors, empty states). Each new screen needs loading/error/empty states. TypeScript only, no `any` abuse, explicit interfaces/types. New stores follow productStore/branchStore house style (zustand + persist via src/store/persistStorage.persistStorage) and call logAction on mutations.
key_patterns: STORE: see src/store/branchStore.ts (function-API zustand+persist, name 'pos-xxx', createJSONStorage(() => persistStorage)) and src/store/productStore.ts (hook-API). AUDIT: logAction(module, action, description, metadata?) from src/store/auditLogStore.ts — module is a Thai noun. WEB SCREEN CRUD: src/screens/web/WebBranchManageScreen.tsx is the canonical sibling (WebColors, card grid, inline add/edit form, window.confirm delete, empty state with Ionicons). WEB REGISTRATION: add a switch case in WebNavigator.tsx renderContent(), a Thai entry in its local PAGE_NAMES, and a NAV_ITEMS entry in src/components/web/WebSidebar.tsx; access gating via canAccess(role, key) in src/constants/rolePermissions.ts — unknown routes map 1:1 to a screen key and admin always passes; routes 'documents'/'licenses'/'branches' reuse the 'settings' key via an inline includes() list in WebNavigator (replicate that pattern to reuse 'products' for new master routes). SYNC: src/store/syncStore.ts is the real store (useSyncStore: transactions, getStats(), startSync(), retryAllFailed(), retryTransaction(id), resolveConflict(id,resolution,manualValue?), lastSyncAt, isSyncing, isOnline; gated by FEATURE_FLAGS.MOCK_SYNC). src/screens/sync/SyncQueueScreen.tsx is a working store-bound reference; src/screens/sync/ConflictResolutionScreen.tsx (props {onBack,onResolved}) resolves conflicts via the store. NOTE: src/screens/settings/SyncMonitorScreen.tsx uses its OWN local MOCK_SYNC, NOT the store — do not copy its data wiring.
directory_structure: src/store = zustand stores (+persist). src/screens/web = back-office web admin screens. src/screens/product, src/screens/inventory, src/screens/sync, src/screens/settings = mobile/shared screens. src/navigation = stack navigators + WebNavigator. src/components/web = WebLayout/WebSidebar/WebTopBar. src/constants = design tokens (colors.ts, typography.ts, spacing.ts, webColors.ts) + rolePermissions.ts. src/data = mock seed data. src/types = shared TS types. Verdict/review file for the workflow loop lives at .agents/tasks/review.json (worktree).
